snippets: def unprocessed_waves(spark, bronze, silver, tracker_id) -> list[str]:
source = spark.table(bronze).filter(F.col("tracker_id") == tracker_id).select("wave_id").distinct()
done = spark.table(silver).filter(F.col("tracker_id") == tracker_id).select("wave_id").distinct()
return sorted(r.wave_id for r in source.join(done, "wave_id", "left_anti").collect())
